exposure: Mean uterine arteries pulsatility index (mUtA PI)
mean uterine arteries pulsatility index (mUtA PI)
outcome: Composite adverse perinatal outcome (APO) including abnormal cardiotocogram, intrapartum pH requiring cesarean section, 5-minute Apgar score < 7, neonatal pH < 7.10, and admission to pediatric care units
cohort: 891 fetuses undergoing ultrasound examination at 34-41 weeks gestation
finding: The cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) alone is the best predictor of adverse perinatal outcomes at the end of pregnancy, and the addition of uterine artery Doppler measurements does not improve its predictive ability.
